about_the_game:
Steel Defense is a dynamic roguelike game in which every battle turns into a test of strength. Collect an arsenal, upgrade your mech and find your own way to victory in the arena.

  • 16 types of weapons with unique upgrades that unlock new tactics.

  • Additional items for flexible customization and enhancement of the mech.

  • Enemies that require a different approach to combat.

  • Bosses who will test your skills and reward you as you deserve.

  • Leaderboards, for the best of the best.

  • A workshop for training and developing combat characteristics.

Get ready and show what you can do!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: A dual-core processor with a clock speed of 2.8 GHz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050TI or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: Every battle is a test. Every choice is a step towards victory. Combine skills, experiment with tactics and find your own style that will turn you into a nightmare for your enemies!
